_readme: Trading settings shared by the Python engine and the NestJS API.
This file is the ONLY place the defaults live. Both runtimes read it at start.
An environment variable with the same name overrides a value (for experiments).
Percent fields ending in _PCT under 'costs' are percentages (0.03 = 0.03%).
RISK_PER_TRADE_PCT is a FRACTION of the cell fund (0.02 = 2%), never 2.
MAX_COST_TO_RISK: a trade is skipped when its round-trip cost (charges + slippage both ways) is more than this share of the rupees it risks. 0 turns the rule off.
lifecycle: when a cell (one stock with one strategy) is paused, resumed or marked proven. Judged on its closed paper trades after costs, in R (profit or loss divided by the rupees risked).
